{{Quote|This is the Genetic Records Hall. It contains data on the original DNA of every being we have ever cloned.|[[AZI-345211896246498721347/Legends|AZI-3]]|<ref name="Fugitive" />}}
The '''Genetic Records Hall''' was a location within [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. The hall contained genetic records and information about the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], produced by the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]].
